scenario: EXAMPLE: delayed offboarding leads to misuse of a former employee's account

threat_event_frequency.label: Threat events per year (a departed user's access is attempted or misused)

vulnerability.label: Probability a threat event becomes a loss event (access still active and useful)

primary_loss.label: Primary loss per loss event, USD (investigation, response, remediation)

secondary_loss_probability.label: Probability a loss event also triggers secondary loss (notification, legal, client impact)

secondary_loss.label: Secondary loss when it occurs, USD
